page.overview:
What is Great Sun?

The inhabitants of the Northern Kingdoms know very little about the cult of the Great Sun. The head of this religion is a high priest, which may also be the Nilfgaardian Emperor.

The Great Sun, known in Nilfgaardian as Ard Feainn, is the dominant religion of the Nilfgaardian Empire and serves as its official state faith. Although today it is inseparable from the authority of the Empire, the cult was not always the central religion of Nilfgaard. For centuries it existed as one faith among many practiced in the imperial heartlands.

Its rise began during the reign of an emperor preceding Fergus var Emreis, who sought a unifying symbol capable of binding the Empire together more effectively than dynastic loyalty alone. Through political patronage, financial support, and legal reforms, the cult was elevated above all others. This process culminated in the March 8th Edict, which established the Great Sun as the Empire’s official religion and transformed much of its priesthood into an extension of the imperial administration.

The faith’s connection to the imperial family grew even stronger under the House of var Emreis. Earlier traditions claimed that Torres var Emreis, founder of the dynasty’s greatness, was the literal incarnation of the Sun and possessed a divine right to rule. Over time this belief softened into the doctrine that the imperial family is blessed by the Great Sun rather than descended from it, though some rural communities continue to preserve the older interpretation.
